{{Quote|We've been contemplating the move for quite some time. For the past few years, it has grown ever more difficult to maintain our shipping schedules with less actual traffic passing through the Corellia sector. Our own freighters have of course been shipping our materials and products, but we can't control the shipping infrastructure, and to be perfectly frank, the Coronet Space Port has entered a rapid decline, to say nothing of the spaceports elsewhere in the sector.|Gohn Danfeil on Gowix Computers decision to relocate to Corulag|<ref name="GNN7" />}}
'''Gohn Danfeil''' was the [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|Chief Executive Officer]] of [[Gowix Computers]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. He presided over the company's move from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]].
